title: The UK's AI stack: change in trade, 2019 to 2025
source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics; ONS trade in services by partner country and QNA; ukmacro calculations
note: Arranged by the CMA's foundation-model value chain (inputs, model development, deployment). Expertise, the other input, isn't traded. Compute hardware = IMF AI hardware basket; AI-embedded goods = the other ONS-based AI products (phones, laptops, network kit, devices). Services by ONS service type (information, R&D, software licences, computer, telecoms, consulting and technical), scaled to the latest QNA totals. Whole categories, so upper bounds: *consulting and technical services are included in full, though AI is a small part of them.
